title: Level 3: Mutex API (API Gateway + DynamoDB, no Lambda)
description:
## Goal

Level 3: Optional hard mutex for workloads where duplicate execution has significant consequences (for example one Spoticus scheduling epoch).

## Primitive

Atomically create/claim resource X if and only if nobody currently owns X. Only one competing request succeeds.

## Proposed implementation

Worker → API Gateway REST API → direct DynamoDB service integration.

- No Lambda
- No AppSync
- API Gateway assumes a narrowly scoped IAM role and performs a DynamoDB conditional write
- Workers need credentials for the Kanbus Mutex API, not AWS account credentials

## Storage

DynamoDB holds only **active** coordination state, not Kanbus history. Conceptual fields: resource_id, owner_id, claim_id, revision, claimed_at, expires_at. Delete on complete. DynamoDB TTL for abandoned leases. Even a busy install should have dozens to hundreds of live records.

Tiny API: acquire, renew, release, perhaps inspect. Prototype and measure actual request cost.

## Depends on

Protocol Gherkin. Git and MQTT remain fallbacks when this provider is not configured.

## Acceptance

Gherkin for acquire/renew/release/inspect and failed conditional checks; dual-runtime client; Git-only and MQTT-only installs unchanged.

comments.text: Acceptance verified against develop. Gherkin: features/coordination/mutex_api.feature covers acquire, competing acquire failing the conditional check, renew, renew rejection on owner/claim mismatch, release, inspect (live and after TTL/release), and live-state-only storage. Dual-runtime clients: rust/src/mutex_api.rs and python/src/kanbus/coordination_mutex_api.py. Infrastructure: infra/cloud/kanbus_cloud/coordination_stack.py (API Gateway REST with direct DynamoDB service integration for lease routes, no Lambda in the lease path) with tests in infra/cloud/tests. Git-only and MQTT-only unchanged: features/coordination/provider_selection.feature (missing endpoint is not an error). Request-cost measurement stays tracked separately in kbs-357ca6 (Backlog). Closing as complete.
